title: Open-Label Study of BBO-10203 in Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors

rules.rule_text: Age >= 18 years
rules.source_text: Minimum age: 18 Years

rules.rule_text: Diagnosis of HER2-positive advanced breast cancer (locally advanced unresectable or metastatic), HR-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer, KRAS mutant advanced colorectal cancer, or KRAS mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer
rules.source_text: Locally advanced and unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive advanced breast cancer (aBC), HR-positive/HER2-negative advanced breast cancer, KRAS mutant advanced colorectal cancer (aCRC), or KRAS mutant advanced non-small cell lung cancer (aNSCLC)

rules.rule_text: Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1
rules.source_text: Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 (except for HR-positive HER2-negative aBC where evaluable bone-only disease is permitted)
rules.notes: HR-positive HER2-negative aBC patients may have evaluable bone-only disease instead

rules.rule_text: ECOG performance status 0 or 1
rules.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) 0-1

rules.rule_text: Adequate LVEF assessed by ECHO or MUGA
rules.source_text: Adequate LVEF assessed by ECHO or MUGA (BBO-10203 + Trastuzumab cohorts only)
rules.notes: No threshold specified; applies only to BBO-10203 + Trastuzumab cohorts

rules.rule_text: Stable brain metastases
rules.source_text: Stable brain metastases

rules.rule_text: At least 2 prior lines of anti-HER2-directed therapy for HER2-positive aBC (or 1 prior line if no other regional SoC available)
rules.source_text: Patients with HER2-positive aBC: Must have had at least 2 prior lines of anti-HER2-directed therapy. Only 1 prior line is acceptable where there is no other regionally available standard of care (SoC)

rules.rule_text: Progression on or disease recurrence after at least one line of SOC treatment, or would be unlikely to tolerate/derive benefit from SoC
rules.source_text: Monotherapy Cohort patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative aBC, KRAS mutant aCRC or aNSCLC: Must have progression on, or disease recurrence after at least one line of SOC treatment or in the opinion of the investigator, would be unlikely to tolerate or derive clinically meaningful benefit from SoC therapy
rules.applies_if: Monotherapy Cohort with HR-positive HER2-negative aBC, KRAS mutant aCRC, or aNSCLC

rules.rule_text: Confirmed PIK3CA mutation for BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant combination cohort
rules.source_text: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant combination cohort patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative aBC: confirmed PIK3CA mutation, must have been treated with a CDK4/6i
rules.applies_if: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant combination cohort with HR-positive HER2-negative aBC

rules.rule_text: Must have been treated with a CDK4/6i for BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant combination cohort
rules.source_text: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant combination cohort patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative aBC: confirmed PIK3CA mutation, must have been treated with a CDK4/6i
rules.applies_if: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant combination cohort with HR-positive HER2-negative aBC

rules.rule_text: Confirmed PIK3CA mutation for BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant + ribociclib combination cohort
rules.source_text: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant + ribociclib combination cohort patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative aBC: confirmed PIK3CA mutation, no prior systemic therapy in the aBC setting permitted
rules.applies_if: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant + ribociclib combination cohort with HR-positive HER2-negative aBC

rules.rule_text: Prior systemic therapy in the aBC setting for BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant + ribociclib combination cohort
rules.source_text: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant + ribociclib combination cohort patients with HR-positive, HER2-negative aBC: confirmed PIK3CA mutation, no prior systemic therapy in the aBC setting permitted
rules.applies_if: BBO-10203 + Fulvestrant + ribociclib combination cohort with HR-positive HER2-negative aBC

rules.rule_text: Prior irinotecan-containing therapy for KRAS mutant aCRC (1 prior line allowed but not required)
rules.source_text: BBO-10203 + FOLFOX + Bevacizumab combination cohort patients with KRAS mutant aCRC: One prior line of irinotecan-containing therapy for locally advanced or metastatic CRC is allowed but not required
rules.applies_if: BBO-10203 + FOLFOX + Bevacizumab combination cohort with KRAS mutant aCRC
rules.notes: 1 prior line is allowed but not required

rules.rule_text: KRAS G12R mutation in KRAS mutant aCRC patients
rules.source_text: Patients with KRAS mutant aCRC who have KRAS G12R mutation, BRAFV600E mutation, HER2amp, or dMMR/MSI-H tumors

rules.rule_text: BRAFV600E mutation in KRAS mutant aCRC patients
rules.source_text: Patients with KRAS mutant aCRC who have KRAS G12R mutation, BRAFV600E mutation, HER2amp, or dMMR/MSI-H tumors

rules.rule_text: HER2amp in KRAS mutant aCRC patients
rules.source_text: Patients with KRAS mutant aCRC who have KRAS G12R mutation, BRAFV600E mutation, HER2amp, or dMMR/MSI-H tumors

rules.rule_text: dMMR/MSI-H tumors in KRAS mutant aCRC patients
rules.source_text: Patients with KRAS mutant aCRC who have KRAS G12R mutation, BRAFV600E mutation, HER2amp, or dMMR/MSI-H tumors

rules.rule_text: KRAS G12R mutation in KRAS mutant aNSCLC patients
rules.source_text: Patients with KRAS mutant aNSCLC who have KRAS G12R mutation, or tumors with other targetable driver mutations (eg, EGFR, anaplastic lymphoma kinase, ROS1/BRAF/RET/MET/EGFR exon20 insertion/NTRK/HER2)

rules.rule_text: Targetable driver mutations (EGFR, anaplastic lymphoma kinase, ROS1, BRAF, RET, MET, EGFR exon20 insertion, NTRK, HER2) in KRAS mutant aNSCLC patients
rules.source_text: Patients with KRAS mutant aNSCLC who have KRAS G12R mutation, or tumors with other targetable driver mutations (eg, EGFR, anaplastic lymphoma kinase, ROS1/BRAF/RET/MET/EGFR exon20 insertion/NTRK/HER2)

rules.rule_text: Untreated and/or non-stable brain metastases
rules.source_text: Patients with untreated and/or non-stable brain metastases
